text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Haa!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I still can't see... the answer. What is 
it that the JRA can't do? Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Right now—all I can do is keep building it 
up! Yaaaaaaaah!

The state of groping in the dark 
continues... Even so, Furioso's effort 
during the training camp was staggering.
(PSSSSHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much. My legs feel 
so much better now.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's take it easy and not push too 
hard.
Yeah, let's not push ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.text:
I'll support her with everything I have. 
Furioso's own stamina doesn't seem to be 
an issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Central Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, sorry, but let's call it a day 
here. To be honest, my body just can't 
take any more...

text_block_list.name: Central Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking off too. Physically I'm fine, 
but from here on I have my own 
personalized menu to do.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes... Thank you very much for 
running alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's quite difficult, isn't it? 
Finding someone to practice with, that is.
choice_data_list: Yeah... Once you reach this level...
Right... Once you reach this level...

text_block_list.text:
Things aren't like they were at the Make 
Debut. Her running ability has increased 
so drastically that few Umamusume can keep 
up.

And strong Umamusume have their own 
training schedules to consider, so they 
won't stick around to accompany you the 
whole way through.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. From here on, I must 
go alone...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What we can do is limited, but... even so, 
it doesn't mean we can't do anything at 
all...

Even so, as a Trainer, I can't just 
overlook this situation.

At the very least, I decided to do 
whatever was within my power.
Furi-pyon!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Furi-pyon, how are you feeling? Your 
Trainer called me over to check on you~.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything we can help with? If 
we're good enough, that is!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... coming all the way from 
Funabashi...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, if you invite me, I'll 
definitely come~. This autumn is a huge 
deal for Funabashi, after all.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Furi-chan, we've been able to 
give it our all lately too. Helping out is 
the least we can do.
choice_data_list: I'm counting on both of you!
I'm counting on both of you!

text_block_list.text:
"I was grateful for the help. Her running 
ability might be far below that of the URA 
Umamusume, but..."

text_block_list.name: Samin & Myu
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh!! Towaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, this running style is...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Could I always run this fast? If I can do 
this much, then—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Alright! Yaaaaaaah!!

"...It was a welcome miscalculation. The 
two of them had grown far more than I 
expected. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, as expected of Furi-pyon... I 
couldn't win at all~...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm completely wiped out too. Feels 
like my heart's gonna burst, but...

text_block_list.name: Samin & Myu
text_block_list.text: Still...!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
I can't be whining now. I can still keep 
going, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Right? After all, the two of us... have 
been watching the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up, growing stronger without 
limit— that's Furipyon!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Even on the day she fought that super 
scary Central champion... Furi-pyon didn't 
flinch at all!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that courage made me realize 
something! I want to become just like that 
someday!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
The race I could never forget is the 
Kashiwa Kinen! Furi-chan carried 
everyone's deepest wish and took the 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an Umamusume who is 
praised like that, too! That's what I 
thought... with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Furi-chan has always led the way for 
us...! She's never stopped pulling us 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to get even just a little 
closer to my idol, Furi-pyon!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

"These two clearly had a different level 
of determination than the other training 
partners."

Inspired and emboldened by Furioso's 
success, they rose up and followed her 
lead. What's more—

For the sake of their hometown Funabashi, 
they are willing to run alongside Furioso 
to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Hey, Furi-pyon... It's not just us.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's not just us. Every Umamusume at 
Funabashi Tracen feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
We want Furi-chan to win, we want to help 
her win. We'll do whatever it takes for 
that.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Like saying, "This is our showdown!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "Our... showdown... Well, then..."

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you're thinking of putting in 
some extra training for the autumn...

text_block_list.name: Samin & Myu
text_block_list.text: Come to Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's getting stronger thanks to your 
inspiration, Furi-chan. Let's do this 
together! Let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Everyone is cheering for me... 
Thank you... so much.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll put together a menu right away!

Yeah, I'll get your training menu ready 
right away!

text_block_list.text:
A light that should never have existed... 
might have just been found. And that is...

—The spark of belonging. It was the light 
of 'representing Funabashi' that they had 
refused to let go.
